definitionZh: 对象位置 CSS 属性指定选定替换元素内容在元素框中的对齐. 框中未覆盖被替换元素对象的区域将显示元素的背景.
sourceDefinition: The object-position CSS property specifies the alignment of the selected replaced elements's contents within the element's box. Areas of the box which aren't covered by the replaced element's object will show the element's background.
